climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A dry white DOCG on the plain between the Tagliamento and Livenza rivers, a few miles from the sea. It is the only Italian DOCG made in two regions, Veneto and Friuli-Venezia Giulia.
